bio: ‘Crumbs’ is a new wave bakery-cum-bistro with a relaxed urban style, owned by a charismatic and exuberant designer. Sit inside to watch the making of the delicious loaves and pastries or head out to the terrace for some people-watching in the part-pedestrianised lane. Modern, flavour-packed small plates are served throughout the day and can be accompanied by something from the biodynamic wine list. Of course, a pastry is a must to finish – the lemon meringue cruffin is a hit....
